messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up: we're rolling out a samples repo split + snippet sandbox next month. Goal: move runnable code out of the monolithic docs site into per-language sample repos and provide ephemeral-token sandboxes for safe execution. This will improve CI testing and reduce flakey snippet runs. Need SDK owners to review the sample repo templates.

oliver (DevEx): Nice. Will this change how the docs render live examples?

maria (Docs): Docs will still show live examples, but they will call the sandbox using ephemeral tokens (no long-lived secrets in docs). We'll also switch to embedding static snapshots for search indexing.

jonathan (SDK): From SDK side: we'll add a small helper to mint ephemeral tokens for the sandbox and a test harness for snippet compatibility. PR draft: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/sdk/pulls/560. Please call out any required API surface before we stabilize the helper.

sam (Release): Timeline? We should avoid holiday blackout windows.

maria (Docs): Proposed timeline: announce to customers 2026-05-05, enable sandbox beta 2026-05-12, gated full switch 2026-06-02. Deprecation note for inline runnable snippets: they will stop executing in prod docs after 2026-06-30.

jonathan (SDK): We'll ensure the helper supports token TTLs and minimal scopes. Also adding a CI job that runs all language samples nightly against the sandbox.

sara (Security): Security asks: 1) ephemeral tokens must be scoped and read-only, 2) sandbox network must be isolated from customer data, 3) audits enabled. Please include threat model in the design doc.

maria (Docs): Agreed. Design doc: https://docs.google.com/designs/samples-sandbox (draft). I'll add the threat model and a security checklist.

docs-bot: Created tracking ticket DOCS-721 for the migration and linked per-language sample repos.

oliver (DevEx): Quick ask: ensure doc authors can preview snippets locally without hitting the sandbox (local emulator or short-lived dev tokens). That will reduce iteration friction.

jonathan (SDK): I'll add a dev flow: `redwood dev-token --ttl 1m --scope sandbox:demo` and a small emulator in `devtools/snippet-emulator`.

maria (Docs): Action items recap: 1) SDK: finalize helper + PR by 2026-04-20, 2) Security: review checklist by 2026-04-22, 3) DevEx: local emulator docs, 4) Docs: publish customer advisory and changelog banner ahead of beta. I'll open follow-up threads for each.

sam (Release): Scheduling a cross-team Q&A 2026-04-23 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants.

maria (Docs): Thanks all 44b — posting rollout notes to the docs channel and will link the sample repo templates once PRs land.
